newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Feb industry output up 0.3 pct vs Jan - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Feb industry output up 0.3 pct vs Jan - IBGE.

text.p: Output by Brazilian industry rose 0.3 percent in February over January and was 2.9 percent higher than in February 1996, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said in a statement.
The cumulative index of the last 12 months rose 3.5 percent against 2.7 percent growth in January, it added.
The 0.3 percent rise in February broke a series of two monthly falls but all the signs since the end of last year point to a period of deceleration, the IBGE said.
Some nine of the 20 sectors covered showed increases in output in February over January, led by the mechanical sector (up 4.4 percent) and non-metallic minerals (up 2.8 percent).
Of the remaining sectors which saw lower production, electrical and telecommunication materials fell three percent and furniture 7.5 percent.
